title: Port trusted feedback and scorecard lineage types
description:
## Scope

Use Item, FeedbackItem, initial_answer_value, final_answer_value, edit_comment_value, label sources, score result, element, feature, decision, and scorecard consistently with Plexus. Preserve review provenance and selection propensity rather than guessing either.

## Definition of done

Specs show feedback records become eligible trusted labels only through explicit normalization and review; changed scorecards and policies retain an audit lineage.

## Acceptance scenario

```gherkin
Feature: Port trusted feedback and scorecard lineage types
  Scenario: Required observable behavior
    Given a review corrects an initial model answer
    When the feedback is recorded
    Then the initial answer, final answer, comment, label source, and selection propensity remain distinguishable
```
